trello.name: Send final renewal terms request to DataBridge
trello.desc: Sofia to send one final email today to DataBridge account manager in plain language requesting revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. Reference prior emails sent, including Monday, and note contract lapses August 29th. Acceptance criteria: email sent today, clearly states deadline of Thursday COB for revised terms, and is documented for follow-up.

trello.name: Escalate DataBridge non-response to Legal
trello.desc: If DataBridge has not replied by Thursday close of business, Sofia to escalate to Legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. Do not wait for Ravi approval; escalation is triggered by non-response by deadline. Acceptance criteria: conditional check completed Thursday COB, escalation email to Legal sent Friday morning if no reply received, with context on prior outreach and contract lapse date.

trello.name: Request security audit cryptography review from Dana

Acceptance criteria: request sent today with report attached, two-week deadline communicated, assessment due before next sync.
